fact: In July 2026 the Ministry of Health and the Ministry of Basic and Secondary Education signed an MoU to link the HMIS with the EMIS so that immunisation, nutrition, screening and birth registration data can be shared with education indicators; the story describes this as to be integrated, with a joint working group set up.

The World Bank ISR for the RISE project records a current value of 0 systems interoperable at 25 November 2025 across the GamSR, education management information systems, CRVS and the health insurance system, with one instance being verified and a target of at least 3 by October 2028.
